rootfs.note: Official ubuntu-base 24.04.5 arm64; sha256 from release SHA256SUMS. Was Debian bookworm — switched to Ubuntu per requirement.

dsh.channel_note: Channels for update-guard (task-6): stable -> npm tag 'latest', alpha -> npm tag 'alpha'. install.sh pins exact version; update-dsh.sh resolves channel->version.

proot.note: System /usr/bin/proot is BROKEN on target devices (musl build; bundled libtalloc.so.2 expects glibc symbols __register_atfork/__errno/__gnu_strerror_r -> relocation error, verified on device image). NEVER use it. Use libproot.so shipped inside the APK.
proot.libs_note: All three .so stay in ONE directory (RUNPATH $ORIGIN). Extracted from APK lib/arm64-v8a/ at build/install time.

layout_on_device.ab_note: Reserved for update-guard (task-6): A/B rootfs prefixes + 'current' symlink live UNDER <app-files>/proot/ (e.g. rootfs.A/, rootfs.B/, current -> A). launch-dsh.sh resolves ROOTFS via the symlink when present, else ./rootfs.

binds.note: requires storage permission; bind skipped if dir unreadable
photo input for agents; read-only by default
